verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents "smart invoice scanning technology" that can automate entering recipient details for payments (jeeves-docs-28). It also offers automated invoice payment and approval flows that provide a review step (jeeves-docs-27), and its MCP server lets agents review bill-pay invoices and manage vendor payment details (jeeves-docs-47). However, the scanning capability rests on a single marketing line with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: explicit AI/OCR extraction documentation, which payment fields are auto-populated, ingestion of incoming bills (e.g., email forwarding), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
